acceptanceDefaults: Preserve the production canvas dimensions and documented physical dimensions.
Keep exactly one connected foreground component unless the source proves otherwise.
Preserve intentional openings and remove accidental transparent damage.
Remove white backgrounds, cast shadows, and detached fragments.
Write byte-identical PNGs to reference/3-charms-each-piece and public/assets/charms/ref.
Do not publish to Shopify until authenticated write access is available.
